authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1200 āpayati explicitly gives Prakrit āvēi/āvaï comes, Punjabi āuṇā, Jaunsari āṇõ, Nepali āunu, Oriya āibā, Hindi ānā with stem āw-, and Gujarati āvvũ. These selected simple present/infinitive/imperative responses preserve regional vowel, glide and b/v realization and endings. Past stems and light-verb compounds are treated separately because the source explicitly says the preterite is usually from āgata. Local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: ave.
